newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse media group EBITDA flat for Q1.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse media group EBITDA flat for Q1.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp said on Friday that its media group had first-quarter earnings of $110 million before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA), matching the year-ago quarter.

On a same-station basis, television revenues declined four percent, although the year-ago quarter benefited from political advertising. CBS had lower EBITDA earnings because in part to lower audience levels in key demographic categories, but the network is growing its share of its target Adult 25-54 audience, Westinghouse said.
